moments.why: This headline captured widespread attention because it marked the long‑awaited Broadway debut of the world’s longest‑running musical, sparking enthusiasm across theater communities.

moments.author: The Hollywood Reporter
moments.quote: Brad Pitt on why Leonardo DiCaprio’s Rick Dalton doesn’t cameo in ‘The Further Mis‑Adventures of Cliff Booth’: “It would have been great fun, but it required a lot of prosthetics, which is a good couple of weeks prepping to get him. It’s hardly worth the cost for a cameo.”
moments.why: It went viral because Pitt’s candid explanation about DiCaprio’s absence combined star power with a humorous production insight, catching wide fan attention.
